title: 知覚・認知心理学A
subtitle: Psychology of Perception and Cognition A
educationalGoal: The basis of human behavior is information processing. This course focuses on sense perception (the mental process of sensory input) and cognition (the mental process of information processing). The neural basis and neural disorder of sense perception and cognition will also be introduced. In addition, the opportunity to think about how to apply sensory and perceptual knowledge to information design will be provided.
advice: The lecture will be given while presenting the main points on slides and blackboard. Textbooks of Introduction to Psychology A and B will be used as reference books. Supplementary materials will be distributed for units and charts not included in the reference books. This subject is eligible for the course credit system.
books: Textbook: None Reference book: Katori, H., Sugimoto, T., Torii, S., & Kawachi, J. (Eds.) (2020). Psychology, 5th revised ed. University of Tokyo Press (ISBN: 978-4-13-012117-0)
requiredKnowledge: It is advisable to review what you have learned in Chapter 5 of Introduction to Psychology A. If you find anything in the class content difficult, please refer to reference books or books in the Library Center collection, or ask questions directly to the faculty member. Students are expected to approach class with a positive attitude, deepening their understanding of the knowledge they have learned in class by experiencing it through their own senses and perceptions.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and explain types and general characteristics of sensation.
Ability to understand and explain mechanisms and functions of perception.
Ability to understand and explain sensory interaction.
Ability to understand and explain functions of attention.
Ability to understand and explain neural basis and disorders in visual perception
Ability to apply knowledge of sensation and perception for information design

achievementLevels.ideal: Understand the workings of the senses and perceptions, explain the workings of the human mind, and consider a research plan to investigate the workings of the mind.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the basic role of sensation and perception and be able to give an account of the workings of the human mind.
